question: In a certain code language, ‘BLAME' is coded as 'CMBNF' and ‘CHANGE' is coded as 'DIBOHF'. What is the code for ‘DESERT' in the given code language?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] Logic : (1) is added to the position value according to English alphabetic series. So, • ‘BLAME' is coded as 'CMBNF'
